archetypes.name: dyn-route-state
archetypes.rationale: Route-state recovery changed and deserves focused resume/fresh-entry review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Step 0b route-state binding change and its regression tests. Focus on whether explicit issue runs skip stale route-state repo recovery while resume-like entries still recover a missing issue number. Check that the tests exercise the route and init argv boundaries rather than only stdout. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
